      General

      GOMO by Singtel is a digital lifestyle brand in Singapore that offers affordable mobile and broadband plans. It runs on Singtel’s reliable network, providing strong coverage and fast connectivity.

       

      GOMO plans are designed for flexibility and value, with features such as:
       

      5G+ mobile plans with large data bundles and roaming options. To use GOMO’s 5G+ network, check your mobile phone is 5G Standalone (SA)-compatible handset.​
      High-speed 10Gbps fibre broadband plans.
      Fully digital account management via the GOMO app with 24/7 live chat support.


      This makes GOMO by Singtel ideal for users who want simple, fast connectivity with the best network performance at competitive prices.

      Go into the GOMO app, locate the “Shop” tab and head over to "Devices & gadgets" to purchase your device directly there!

      All promotions are valid for a limited time only. Applicable discounts and benefits will be reflected at checkout.​

       

      The Lucky 8 Promo  is GOMO’s latest social campaign, built around the idea that “Luck follows GOMO switchers.” It features GOMO’s 5G+ plans at $8/mth. Each week, GOMO shares a set of lucky numbers on its social pages and invites followers to comment on what lucky numbers mean to them. Customers who port in to GOMO can unlock a limited set of lucky charms, including the GOMO plush and 8-shaped accessories. Read on to find out how the promo works and how to take part.

       

      For GOMO x nEbO  promotional T&Cs, click here.

       

      For GOMO x Cheers NSF Offer  promotional T&Cs, click here.

      Unlimited Local data will have up to 1,024GB for usage.
      Unlimited MINS/SMS will have up to 1,500MINS/SMS for usage.
      Unlimited Asia roaming bundled to plans will have 100GB, throttle to lower speed thereafter.
      Unlimited International roaming will have 200GB, throttle to lower speed thereafter.

      You can sign up online for a GOMO SIM-only mobile plan if you are aged 16 and above. No deposit is required.

       

      Simply prepare:

      Your credit or virtual credit card
      MyInfo for verification

       

      Your GOMO eSIM will be sent by email, while physical SIM cards will be delivered to your doorstep. Delivery fees may apply. Please refer to the latest checkout details before confirming your order.

       

      We’ll send you an email to install your eSIM. Make sure your device is eSIM compatible and you’re connected to the internet during installation.

      You can purchase roaming packs for single destinations (Roam Single Destination) or multiple destinations in a region (Roam More Destinations).

       

      Broadband

      GOMO Broadband is our 10Gbps fibre broadband service for homes in Singapore, offering simple plans at $29.99, billed every 30 days.

      The main difference is contract length and what’s included:
       

      The GOMO 10Gbps Value Saver Plan comes with a 24-month contract, a free WiFi 7 router, installation and NLT activation.
      The GOMO 10Gbps Core Saver Plan comes with a 12-month contract and free NLT activation. No router is included, so you can use your own or buy one separately. GOMO Customers can purchase a router on the GOMO app.
       

      Both 10Gbps plans are priced at $29.99, billed every 30 days.

      Yes. Customers with an active GOMO mobile plan can enjoy GOMO Broadband at $28.80, billed every 30 days. Limited time offer

       

      Your GOMO mobile plan must already be active before you sign up for broadband.

       

      Eligibility:

      You have at least one active GOMO Mobile plan 
      Your mobile and broadband plans must be under the same NRIC/account

       

      How it works:

      Make sure your GOMO Mobile plan is active
      Sign up for any GOMO 10Gbps Broadband plan  
      Your discount is automatically applied when eligibility is met  

      After you sign up, we’ll sort out your NetLinkTrust (NLT) activation and send updates by SMS or email within 5 days.
       

      You can also track your order in the GOMO app. Installation is included if you selected the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan.

      Free installation and free NLT activation is included with the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan.
       

      Free NLT activation is included with the 10Gbps Core Saver Plan.

      If you choose the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan, a free WiFi 7 router is included.
       

      If you choose the Core Saver Plan, you can use your own compatible router, or purchase one separately. GOMO customers can purchase a router on the GOMO app.

What are the Unlimited* benefits on 5G+ Asia Infinity and Global Infinity plans?
Unlimited Local data will have up to 1,024GB for usage.
Unlimited MINS/SMS will have up to 1,500MINS/SMS for usage.
Unlimited Asia roaming bundled to plans will have 100GB, throttle to lower speed thereafter.
Unlimited International roaming will have 200GB, throttle to lower speed thereafter.
How do I sign up for a GOMO mobile plan?
You can sign up online for a GOMO SIM-only mobile plan if you are aged 16 and above. No deposit is required.
Simply prepare:
Your credit or virtual credit card
MyInfo for verification
Your GOMO eSIM will be sent by email, while physical SIM cards will be delivered to your doorstep.
Delivery fees may apply. Please refer to the latest checkout details before confirming your order.
​How do I set up my GOMO eSIM?
We’ll send you an email to install your eSIM. Make sure your device is eSIM compatible and you’re connected to the internet during installation.
What roaming plans are available on GOMO?
You can purchase roaming packs for single destinations (Roam Single Destination) or multiple destinations in a region (Roam More Destinations).
Broadband
What is GOMO Broadband?
GOMO Broadband is our 10Gbps fibre broadband service for homes in Singapore, offering simple plans at $29.99, billed every 30 days.
What is the difference between the GOMO Broadband Value Saver Plan and Core Saver Plan?
The main difference is contract length and what’s included:
The GOMO 10Gbps Value Saver Plan comes with a 24-month contract, a free WiFi 7 router, installation and NLT activation.
The GOMO 10Gbps Core Saver Plan comes with a 12-month contract and free NLT activation. No router is included, so you can use your own or buy one separately. GOMO Customers can purchase a router on the GOMO app.
Both 10Gbps plans are priced at $29.99, billed every 30 days.
Can GOMO mobile customers get a discount on GOMO Broadband?
Yes. Customers with an active GOMO mobile plan can enjoy GOMO Broadband at $28.80, billed every 30 days. Limited time offer
Your GOMO mobile plan must already be active before you sign up for broadband.
Eligibility:
You have at least one active GOMO Mobile plan
Your mobile and broadband plans must be under the same NRIC/account
How it works:
Make sure your GOMO Mobile plan is active
Sign up for any GOMO 10Gbps Broadband plan
Your discount is automatically applied when eligibility is met
What happens after I sign up for GOMO Broadband?
After you sign up, we’ll sort out your NetLinkTrust (NLT) activation and send updates by SMS or email within 5 days.
You can also track your order in the GOMO app. Installation is included if you selected the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan.
Are installation and NLT activation included with GOMO Broadband?
Free installation and free NLT activation is included with the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan.
Free NLT activation is included with the 10Gbps Core Saver Plan.
Do I need to buy a router for GOMO Broadband?
If you choose the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan, a free WiFi 7 router is included.
If you choose the Core Saver Plan, you can use your own compatible router, or purchase one separately. GOMO customers can purchase a router on the GOMO app.
